policy: These are specialized required proofs, not additional points. No route may be called engineering-certified at 100 when a gate is unknown or failed. Unknown evidence never earns points. This file is a planning contract, not a source of live verification.

gates.requirement: Exact Steam RM/DM rating authority, SteamID64 and alias joins independently reconciled
Watcher-final, disconnect/desync veto and replay outcome precedence verified
Rank ties, full roster search, scope, sort and pagination stable on production-scale fixtures
RM/DM lane freshness, cancellation, cache invalidation and bounded query evidence
Basic/Advanced/Extreme, keyboard, mobile, history and bookmarks tested in real browser
Original stakes, holds, fee, refund and matched-only accounting independently conserved
Owner authorization, no duplicate settlement, uncertain outcomes and retry fences verified
Read-only views audited for inadvertent settlement, payout or signing effects
Live-chain custody and financial activation explicitly distinguished from read-only page delivery
Final artifact hash, exact-current replay identity and immutable original bytes independently checked
Disconnect, desync and unknown result never laundered into a verified winner
Pagination and large replay archive load tested without unbounded hotpath reads
Only eligible actors can accept, withdraw, challenge or adjudicate a result
Lifecycle idempotency, participant counts, expiry and duplicate challenges proven
Challenge display and read activity cannot accidentally trigger money-moving behavior
Title holder, transfer chronology, eligibility and disputes supported by canonical records
Bounty/tribute estimates cannot appear as paid transactions without authoritative receipts
Responsive belt views and historical/current title state remain coherent across site
Candidate and all transitive route dependencies accounted for or explicit unresolved gaps
Every scored criterion bound to inspectable exact-version proof; no unverified 100
Stale, drifted, provisional and unknown measurements cannot masquerade as certified
Exact Git source, manifest, gate, deployed artifact and controller identities agree
Unsafe candidate, stale receipts, replayed permits and incomplete rollout fail closed
Staged activation, health soak and proven rollback remain independent of Wolo settlement
Live versus replayed media and broadcast provenance honestly labeled
Large media files, preloads, polling and background activity remain bounded
Keyboard, captions or accessible alternatives, mobile and errors tested
Citizen counts exclude system agents and placeholder/house avatars without false claims
Steam identity, names, wallet ownership and claimed status correctly distinguished
